Eurolinks in protest of "ongoing genocide" https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/france-dockworkers-at-marseille-port-block-israel-bound-shipment-of-machine-gun-components-made-by-co-eurolinks-in-protest-of-ongoing-genocide/ “French dock workers block arms shipment to Israel” …French dock workers at a southern port are blocking the shipment of military equipment bound for Israel in protest at Israeli actions against Palestinians in Gaza, their union said. The stevedores at the port in Fos-sur-Mer outside Marseille have refused to load crates of links used to assist the rapid fire of bullets aboard the cargo vessel, the CGT trade union said. Links are small metal pieces used to connect machine gun bullets, allowing for rapid bursts of fire. There has been concern in media and among rights groups that they have likely been used against civilians in the Gaza Strip. Christophe Claret, leader of the dock workers in the port, said they had been notified that the ship was due to be loaded on Thursday with the equipment… According to the union, the cargo is 19 pallets of links manufactured by the Marseille-based company Eurolinks. The CGT said the move made clear its refusal to "participate in the ongoing genocide orchestrated by the Israeli government." Leading rights groups have accused Israel of committing genocide in its military campaign, a charge vehemently rejected by the government…

item.title: One problem
item.description: https://www.reddit.com/r/humor/s/lzOu5bNjjh https://www.taxnotes.com/tax-history-project/tax-history-why-presidents-are-audited-every-year/2019/02/22/2957m Tax History: Why Presidents Are Audited Every Year The Internal Revenue Manual requires an audit for every income tax return filed by a sitting U.S. president or vice president. That requirement, which first appeared in 1977, is part of a broader set of procedures governing the treatment of White House returns. And while general in nature, it arose within a specific historical context: the aftermath of the Nixon presidency. Three parts of the IRM outline the procedures for dealing with presidential and vice presidential returns: Part 3, Chapter 28, section 3; Part 4, Chapter 2, section 1; and Part 4, Chapter 8, section 4. As the Joint Committee on Taxation noted in a recent report, the procedures for processing presidential and vice presidential returns differ from those applied to returns filed by mere mortals. To begin with, presidential and vice presidential returns must be mailed to the field director of the Austin Submission Processing Center in Texas, rather than to a service center based on place of residence. The field director or a designated subordinate then processes the returns, taking care to ensure that “the original returns are not unnecessarily folded or bent, and the edit marks and stamps are neatly placed on the returns, since they are deemed permanent records by the National Archives.”

item.description: Keeping all 8 major streaming services ad-free now costs about $61 more each month than it did 4 years ago. Bought separately, those subscriptions add up to roughly $151 a month, compared with about $90 then. Disney+ alone costs $21.49 a month without ads, up from its $6.99 launch price on November 12, 2019. Hulu's ad-free plan is also $21.49. Both rose by $2.50 on September 23, 2026. Netflix Standard reached $19.99 in March 2026, compared with $12.99 in January 2019. Apple TV launched at $4.99 a month in 2019 and reached $14.99 in August 2026. Executives have described room to keep raising prices. In 2024, Disney CEO Bob Iger said: “Every time we've taken a price increase, we've had only modest churn from that, nothing that we would consider significant.” Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav said in 2025: “We think we're way underpriced.” Household spending reflects a different mix of subscriptions. Deloitte's survey puts the average at about $69 a month for roughly 4 services, with 68% paying for at least 1 plan with ads. Asked about a $5 price increase, 61% said they'd cancel a favorite service.

item.title: Body Swap
item.description:
We want to remember the good internet. The cat clips, the funny family tales, the great comic feats. The internet that makes us laugh. That's the internet we grew up on and the the one we want want to be a part of. We know that the world wide web is not always a great place. Its like we are full of contradictions. One moment you're laughing at a tortoise enjoying a fresh lettuce leaf, the next you stumble across some heinous hateful trash. Thats what it feels like to be online today. Your brain cannot stand this whiplash. Sometimes we want to throw our phones into the river and be done with it all. But then we remember you, our readers. And the good internet. And that its not time to give up just yet. If you want to support our work, here's the link: https://www.patreon.com/warandpeas
If you’ve been reading our comics for a while, you’ll know that we’re a bunch of tree-huggin’ saps. We love using our silly talents to spread our appreciation of Mother Nature. Comics have thus far been our favorite medium to do so. But a few years ago, an idea started brewing in our minds: what if we left the world of drawing and make-believe and created something out there, a real place with real trees. And thus an idea grew: let’s plant a forest.
And what kind of forest would we want to build? A FUNNY FOREST of course. And we’re building it with the help of you and our community on Patreon. Everybody told us this idea was crazy. Everybody except the Naturlandstiftung Saar, who said, “Sure, we’ll help you build a funny forest” – which is good news for the trees because they plant trees for a living. But we still need help and that’s where you come in. If you want us to plant a tree for you, listen up:
- You’re already a patron? You get a tree! - You’re not a patron yet? Sign up and you get a tree. - The deadline to sign up is November 30th, 2026 (because at some point we have to tell the tree people a number) - You want to plant it yourself? Come to our planting party. If you can’t make it, we’ll plant it for you. - Where is the planting party? On the Peterberg in beautiful Nonnweiler, Saarland, Germany. - When is it? Early December, we hope. The exact date depends on the weather but we will let you know in time. Join the party here: https://www.patreon.com/warandpeas Let’s plant a freaking forest! Forever yours, Elizabeth and Jonathan
